note: Selected controls evaluated against named requirements. This is not conformity to any whole standard, and no score is derived from it.

controls.requirement: Enforcement is per connection and off by default
controls.control: PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON with read-back on every connection

controls.requirement: Online backup yields a consistent copy
Ambiguous message framing must not be processed
controls.control: reject Transfer-Encoding, duplicate and malformed Content-Length

controls.requirement: Untrusted data rendered safely in context
controls.control: attribute escaping, scheme allowlist, sink inventory

controls.requirement: Archive and review evidence of the release integrity
controls.control: exact-SHA verifier, provider digest, required test identities

controls.requirement: Know what source and dependencies produced a result
controls.control: provenance receipt, pinned actions, hash-locked requirements, SBOM. No SLSA level is claimed: unsigned
controls.counterexample: changed pin or lock against an old receipt

controls.control: lead journey by keyboard in both themes and two profiles
controls.counterexample: focus off screen or lost to body
controls.evidence: automated only; screen reader NOT evaluated

controls.requirement: Reflow at 320 px and text spacing
Lab LCP and CLS within declared budget
controls.control: budgets recomputed independently from raw samples; INP null
